title: CMoralEval: A Moral Evaluation Benchmark for Chinese Large Language Models
findings: The paper's findings focus on the overall moral reasoning performance of Chinese LLMs across different moral categories (e.g., Familial Morality, Social Morality) and scenarios. It does not report specific findings related to Confucianism, but rather uses it as a foundational element in designing the benchmark's moral principles.
